prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["How to Interact with Your Desktop Companion", "Quick shortcuts to move, talk to, or minimize your pet anytime.", "Alt+P to toggle visibility | Click & Drag to relocate | Right-click for pet menu"]
2: ["Choose Your Companion", "Preview animations live on stage before finalizing.", "Select archetype"]
3: ["Restore an Existing Pet", "Already have a companion? Sign in to bring your saved pet to this device.", "Restore Saved Companion", "Signing in links your pet to your account across reinstalls."]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet for Your Desktop...", "Estimated initialization time: 30 seconds", "Desktop Pet Tips"]
5: ["Sign In to Protect Your Pet Profile", "Use your primary account so your pet's memory, items, and personality are never lost.", "Always use the same login option to access your saved pet."]
6: ["Choose How You Want to Begin", "Select pre-made companion for instant setup or custom generator for unique traits."]
7: ["Your Companion is Live on Your Desktop!", "Check your taskbar and screen corner. Your pet is now active.", "Overlay Active"]
8: ["Upload Clear Photos for Best Results", "Provide a front-facing photo in good lighting to generate an accurate 3D desktop companion.", "Avoid dark lighting or crowded backgrounds."]
9: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Meet a virtual companion that lives directly on your computer desktop."]
